name: Mystery Incorporated
source:
Still reeling from the loss of their friends and families, Fred, Velma, Daphne, Shaggy, and Scooby find themselves thrown into a world where the evil entity was never sealed below Crystal Cove. Their friends and families were never devoured and they never reformed Mystery Incorporated. In fact this new dimension seems to be Mystery free???

And yet they can't help but feel unease as their confronted by the faces of those they know to be dead, but alive and well and living the best versions of themselves. Plans are being made for Fred's and Daphne's wedding, Shaggy, and Scooby are Master Chefs, and Velma is in Love with Marcie (Hot Dog Water). All seems prefect . . . a little too perfect, and they cant help but feel that something is EVIL is on the horizon.

                                   EVIL doesn't Die EASY

[From itch.io]
